propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity (CCN 16-22) due to duplicated reduce-and-filter loops and hand-rolled BFS skeletons.
A shared load_indexed_states helper eliminates verbatim duplication of the 'reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index by id' pattern between _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph.

A shared accumulator-based bfs skeleton unifies the BFS traversal logic across _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level while preserving their distinct node-set semantics (accumulator excludes seed, includes unreachable targets).
Refactoring preserves all function node-sets and traversal results; all existing tests in tests/scripts/graph/ and tests/scripts/test_ticket_unblock.py pass without modification.
Complexity baseline is shrunk; all four targeted functions fall below the CCN threshold of 15 (measured ≤ 7), allowing their baseline entries to be removed entirely.
